title: ZitadelProjectConfig
description: The project configuration `zitadel setup` writes to `zitadel.json` at the app's root. The CLI reads it; the server never does.

$schema.description: The editor's pointer at this document, `./.zitadel/meta/project.json`.

project.description: The id of the Zitadel project this app signs users in to. It matches `project_id` in `.zitadel/secret`.

server.description: The origin of the Zitadel server the project lives on.

id.description: The framework's id, as `zitadel setup --framework` takes it.

branding.description: How the app renders the sign-in screens.

renderer.description: The component the sign-in pages render with. `default` is a legacy alias of `react`.

attribution.description: Whether the sign-in screens show the Zitadel attribution.

environments.description: The origins the app signs users in from, per environment.

issuer.description: The origin the dev server serves the app from.

issuer_pattern.description: Origin patterns preview deployments may register from.

preset.description: The sign-in preset `zitadel setup` scaffolded. Guidance only: the schema and flow files decide behavior.

useCase.description: Who signs in, as `zitadel setup --use-case` recorded it. Guidance only: the schema and flow files decide behavior.
